description: A sleek black Subaru STI sports car is prominently featured, parked on a gravel driveway. The vehicle has a glossy finish, a rear spoiler, custom multi-spoke alloy wheels, and visible 'STI' badging on the front fender. It displays a UK license plate 'T300 PPP'. The background includes a brick building with a dark wooden door, black-framed windows, and a hedge. Additional elements are a wooden fence, trees, and a gravel surface, suggesting a rural or suburban setting with natural light illuminating the scene.
